say:9:1064201004:0.text:
Look! A golden magic circle!
It's the reinforcements!
say:9:1064201004:0.source_cn: 看呐！金色的魔法阵！\n是援军的魔法阵！

say:11:1064201006:1.text: What are you talking about? Of course I am!
say:11:1064201006:1.source_cn: 说什么呢！我当然还活着！

say:12:1064201007:1.text: We made a promise, remember? When this war is over, we'll go back to your place and drink your mother's wine.
say:12:1064201007:1.source_cn: 不是说好了？等这场仗打完，要回你家，喝你母亲酿的酒。

say:13:1064201008:1.text: I haven't even tasted it yet. I'm not dying here, and neither are you.
say:13:1064201008:1.source_cn: 我连酒味都没闻到呢，可不能死在战场上，你也不能。

say:14:1064201009:1.text: Help's almost here. We're both getting out of this alive. We can still save a few more. Just a bit more and—
say:14:1064201009:1.source_cn: 援军马上到了，你我都死不了，我们还能再多救几个战友！只...

say:21:1064201013:1.text: <shk>Die... you blasted Hypofiends!! I'll kill you all!</shk>
say:21:1064201013:1.source_cn: <shk>杀了你……该死的魔物！我要杀了你！</shk>

say:25:1064201014:0.source_cn: 必须杀了你！魔物……都得死……

say:36:1064201021:0.text: Ain opens his eyes. His mother is there in front of him, with worry etched into every line of his mother's tired face.
say:36:1064201021:0.source_cn: 埃因睁开眼，望着眼前的母亲，从母亲疲惫的脸上，他看见藏...

say:37:1064201022:0.text: When did she last smile? He can't remember.
say:37:1064201022:0.source_cn: 母亲上次笑是什么时候？他想不起来。

say:38:1064201023:1.text: Perhaps the only time was the day he returned alive, when she wept with joy. Since then, sorrow was all that remained.
say:38:1064201023:1.source_cn: 好像只有他活着回来的那天，母亲喜极而泣。自那以后，只剩...

say:39:1064201024:1.text: Every time his eyes met hers, it felt like an invisible hand tightening around his neck.
say:39:1064201024:1.source_cn: 每每和担忧自己的母亲对上视线，都有一双无形的手伸出来，...

say:40:1064201025:0.text: Ain feels like he can't breathe again. He shuts his eyes hard and turns away.
say:40:1064201025:0.source_cn: 这一次，埃因又觉得喘不上气了，于是他用力合上眼，不再去看。

say:42:1064201026:0.text: You were yelling... That nightmare again?
say:42:1064201026:0.source_cn: 你叫得好大声……又做那个噩梦了？

say:44:1064201028:0.text: *Sigh* If you don't want to talk, then don't. The flowers in the yard are in bloom. Want to take a look?
say:44:1064201028:0.source_cn: 唉……不说就不说吧。院里的花开了，妈推你去看看。

say:45:1064201029:0.text: Your friends from the army wrote again. This one's from Cate and Samir. You still haven't read Lorne's.
say:45:1064201029:0.source_cn: 对了，你的战友又给你寄了信来。这次是凯特和萨米尔，上次...

say:47:1064201031:0.text: Come on. Put your arm around my shoulder. I'll help you sit up first, then I can change your bedpan.
say:47:1064201031:0.source_cn: 来，勾着我的肩膀，妈扶你坐起来，咱先把尿布换了。

say:49:1064201033:0.text: You can't manage this on your own with your legs like that. Let me help—
say:49:1064201033:0.source_cn: 你的腿又不能动，这些事让妈来——

say:50:1064201034:0.text: I said I don't need it! How many times do I have to repeat myself?
say:50:1064201034:0.source_cn: 我说了！用不着！你还要让我说多少回？！

say:52:1064201036:0.text: I'm a grown man who can't even take care of himself! And my own mother has to change me!
say:52:1064201036:0.source_cn: 我这么大的人，竟然要用尿布！更别说还要让自己的妈帮我换！

say:53:1064201037:0.text: I'd rather have died back there with Micah and the others.
say:53:1064201037:0.source_cn: 如果一辈子都这样……当初，我不如陪迈克尔他们一起死！

say:54:1064201038:0.text:
How about me?!
The Hypofiends already took your father. How am I supposed to go on if I lose you, too?
say:54:1064201038:0.source_cn: 妈不要你死！\n你爹已经被魔物杀了，要是你没了……让妈...

say:55:1064201039:1.text: I prayed every single day when you were away at war... I begged Dura to bring you home alive.
say:55:1064201039:1.source_cn: 你去打仗，妈每天都向艾雅女神祈祷……希望你活着回来，女...

say:56:1064201040:1.text: I pray at the temple now, begging the goddess to heal your legs.
say:56:1064201040:1.source_cn: 现在妈也每天去神殿，每天都向女神祈祷！祈祷你的双腿能恢...

say:57:1064201041:0.text: She answered me once before. She'll answer me again.
say:57:1064201041:0.source_cn: 女神也一定会回应我的！

say:59:1064201043:0.text: If the goddess does hear us, then Micah...
say:59:1064201043:0.source_cn: 要是她真能听到祈祷，迈克尔他……

say:61:1064201045:0.text: After all that happened, I can't believe you're still defending him!
say:61:1064201045:0.source_cn: 你老提那个人！他害你那么惨，你还提！

say:62:1064201046:0.text: This is what saving him cost you!
say:62:1064201046:0.source_cn: 要不是为了救他，你这两条腿，不至于弄成这副德行！

say:65:1064201049:0.source_cn: 让我自己待着吧，算我求你……

say:66:1064201050:1.text: Euria parts her lips, then closes them again. The words cling to her tongue. In the end, she swallows them.
say:66:1064201050:1.source_cn: 尤里娅的双唇开了又合，她在口中咀嚼着那些粘牙的话，最终...

say:68:1064201052:1.text: I'll come back once breakfast is ready.

say:69:1064201053:0.text: Ain hears the door close. After a long pause, the footsteps outside finally drifted farther and farther away.
say:69:1064201053:0.source_cn: 埃因听到关门声，隔了很久，门外才传来渐行渐远的脚步声。

say:73:1064201056:0.text: Only to end up like this?

say:4:1064202002:1.text: The nightmare circles back like it always does. Ain knows it too well. All he can do is pray to wake before it goes any further.
say:4:1064202002:1.source_cn: 周而复始的噩梦……埃因再熟悉不过。他祈祷着自己能马上清醒。

say:5:1064202003:1.text: Soon enough, Micah will appear, grabbing his shoulders, calling to him until the Hypofiends' wild laughter swallows everything.
say:5:1064202003:1.source_cn: 要不了多久，迈克尔又会在梦中出现，摇晃他，呼唤他，直到...

say:14:1064202007:1.text: Ain jolts awake. There is a girl in the pale moonlight, looking down at him.
say:14:1064202007:1.source_cn: 埃因猛地撑开眼睛。清冷的月光下，有个小女孩正站在一旁，...

say:15:1064202008:1.text: She hugs a strange-looking unicorn doll to her chest.
say:15:1064202008:1.source_cn: 小女孩怀着还抱着一只造型奇特的……独角兽玩偶。

say:19:1064202011:1.text: I can hear the sound of gunfire... Why are you here alone? It's dangerous.
say:19:1064202011:1.source_cn: 能听到炮火声……小姑娘，你为什么一个人待在这里？这里很危险。

say:21:1064202013:1.text: There's a fight not far from here... Hypo—those horrible creatures could reach the village at any time.
say:21:1064202013:1.source_cn: 远处在打仗，魔……唔，那些可怕的怪物，随时可能入侵村子……

say:22:1064202014:1.source_cn: 可是，大哥哥，你不是也没走吗？

say:23:1064202015:1.text: Anyone who could run has already fled. Why didn't you go with them?
say:23:1064202015:1.source_cn: 能逃跑的人，都离开了。你不和他们一起吗？

say:26:1064202018:1.text: I have to join everyone and kill those Hypofiends that are destroying the world!
say:26:1064202018:1.source_cn: 我得和大家一起，杀了那些祸害世间的魔物！

say:27:1064202019:1.text:
Kill Hypofiends?
But isn't that what soldiers and mages are for?
say:27:1064202019:1.source_cn: 杀魔物……？\n这种事，不是应该交给士兵，和魔法师吗。

say:28:1064202020:1.text: Can't you tell? I am a soldier!
say:28:1064202020:1.source_cn: 你看不出来吗？我就是士兵啊！

say:29:1064202021:1.text: Mmm. You are dressed like one...
say:29:1064202021:1.source_cn: 唔，你的确穿着士兵的衣服……

say:30:1064202022:1.text: But this village is nowhere near the front. And you were clearly sleeping when I found you.
say:30:1064202022:1.source_cn: 可是，这座村子离前线很远……你为什么会在这里睡觉？

say:31:1064202023:1.text: Don't look at me like that. I'm confused, too...
say:31:1064202023:1.source_cn: 别用那种眼神看我，我也不知道自己为什么会出现在这里……

say:32:1064202024:1.text: Oh? Could you be a deserter?

say:34:1064202026:1.text: Wh-What? I didn't hear a thing...
say:34:1064202026:1.source_cn: 有、有人说话吗？我没听到……

say:35:1064202027:0.text: You're so tense you're hearing things... Maybe it was just a bird up in the trees?
say:35:1064202027:0.source_cn: 大哥哥，你太紧张了……是不是把树梢上的鸟鸣听错了？

say:36:1064202028:0.text: There are barely any birds left here. Anyway, I—
say:36:1064202028:0.source_cn: 这地方哪还有几只鸟？总之，我——

say:40:1064202030:0.text: Following a deafening blast, a blinding red flare rises at the horizon. The boom makes Ain flinch back and shiver before he can stop himself.
say:40:1064202030:0.source_cn: 伴随着巨大的爆炸声，刺目的火红从天边飞起。如同惊雷的声...

say:41:1064202031:0.text: Another suffocating night like this. Gunfire. Explosions. These are the final memories of the battlefield he still carries. He couldn't save Micah. His life, like his comrades, plunged into darkness, never to see the morning light again.
say:41:1064202031:0.source_cn: 同样昏沉的夜晚和可怖的袭击，构成了他对于战场的最后记忆...

say:44:1064202033:0.source_cn: 我、我没有害怕……<shk>我不是逃兵！！</shk>

say:45:1064202034:0.text: I know... You've fought to the very end.
say:45:1064202034:0.source_cn: 我知道……你不是逃兵，你战斗到了最后一刻。

say:46:1064202035:0.text: Everyone knows that... including the goddess Dura.
say:46:1064202035:0.source_cn: 大家都知道……艾雅女神，也知道。

say:47:1064202036:0.text: Ain looks at her blankly. For a brief moment, her silhouette perfectly overlaps the statue of Dura as if she were the goddess made flesh.
say:47:1064202036:0.source_cn: 埃因恍惚地望着她，有那么一瞬间，她的身影竟与艾雅女神的...

say:48:1064202037:0.text: But... but the war isn't over yet. The end hasn't come. I have to go back. They need me!
say:48:1064202037:0.source_cn: 但是……但是战争还没有结束，最后一刻还没有来临……我得...

say:49:1064202038:0.text: No, wait. This place won't stay untouched for long, and it's too dangerous for you to be alone. I need to get you somewhere safe first.
say:49:1064202038:0.source_cn: ……不，不行。不能把你独自留在这里。战火蔓延的速度很快...

say:51:1064202040:1.text: I'm weak. I get tired easily. I won't be able to keep up with you... And I'll only slow you down if Hypofiends show up.
say:51:1064202040:1.source_cn: 我的力气很小，体力很差，跟不上你的步子……万一遇到魔物...

say:52:1064202041:0.text: I might get you killed... or worse.
say:52:1064202041:0.source_cn: 说不定，你会被我害死……或者是，比死更惨……

say:53:1064202042:0.text: Will you still take me with you?
say:53:1064202042:0.source_cn: 即便这样，你也要带着我吗？

say:56:1064202045:0.text: I'll protect you even if we're facing an abyss.
say:56:1064202045:0.source_cn: 哪怕坠入深渊，我也会保护你。

say:57:1064202046:0.text: I swore an oath, as one of the Expeditionary Force... to protect everyone.
say:57:1064202046:0.source_cn: 身为远征军的一员……我发过誓，要保护所有人。

say:59:1064202048:0.text: H-How do you know my name?
say:59:1064202048:0.source_cn: 你……你怎么知道我的名字？

say:62:1064202051:0.text: O-Obviously. There's no one else here.
say:62:1064202051:0.source_cn: 当、当然……这里没有其他人。

say:63:1064202052:0.text: How else would I know it?
say:63:1064202052:0.source_cn: 如果不是你告诉我，我怎么可能知道呢？

say:64:1064202053:0.source_cn: 呃，也许真是我忘了自己说过……

say:65:1064202054:0.source_cn: 对了，你叫什么？我还不知道你的名字。

say:2:1064203001:0.text: We've been fortunate. No Hypofiends so far. But don't lower your guard yet—these ones track by scent better than sound. We'll circle around the thorn thicket on the west side.
say:2:1064203001:0.source_cn: 算我们运气好，到现在都没撞见魔物。但不能大意，这里的魔...

say:4:1064203002:0.text: You really know your way around here.
say:4:1064203002:0.source_cn: 埃因哥哥，你对这里好像很了解。

say:5:1064203003:1.text: I just know how Hypofiends hunt.
say:5:1064203003:1.source_cn: 不，我只是比较了解魔物。

say:7:1064203004:0.text: Did you hear that? Something's moving...
say:7:1064203004:0.source_cn: ……埃因哥哥，你听到了吗？草丛里有奇怪的声音……

say:8:1064203005:1.text: Don't panic. I'll take a look. Stay close and keep quiet.
say:8:1064203005:1.source_cn: 别害怕，我去看看。你跟在我身后，不要惊扰它。

narration:9:1064203006:0.text: Ain tightens his grip on his sword and lowers his stance as he creeps toward the rustling brush.
narration:9:1064203006:0.source_cn: 埃因握紧手中的剑，压低重心向发出声音的草丛走去

narration:10:1064203007:0.text: But when he parts the tall grass, what he sees takes him by surprise.
narration:10:1064203007:0.source_cn: 当他拨开野草，出现在眼前的景象却令他震惊不已

say:15:1064203009:0.source_cn: 迈克尔……迈克尔？！真的是你！

say:16:1064203010:1.text: Stay with me! It's me, Ain!

say:20:1064203012:1.text: He's hurt really badly. He needs help.
say:20:1064203012:1.source_cn: 埃因哥哥，他受了很重的伤……需要治疗。

say:21:1064203013:1.text: The adults said there are doctors and mages from the temple behind the lines. They can heal wounds.
say:21:1064203013:1.source_cn: 大人们说，战场的后方有医生，有圣堂的魔法师，他们可以治...

say:25:1064203017:1.text: Why not? He just needs treatment.

say:26:1064203018:1.text: I don't know! We just can't! None of us will make it if we bring him along!
say:26:1064203018:1.source_cn: 我不知道……总之我们不能带他走……如果带着他，谁都活不了！

say:27:1064203019:1.text: But you know him... He's your comrade, isn't he?
say:27:1064203019:1.source_cn: 可是你认识他……他是你的战友，对不对？

say:28:1064203020:1.text: And then what? Save him, only for Hypofiends to catch us again? So all three of us can die here?
say:28:1064203020:1.source_cn: 救了他，然后呢？像上次一样，被魔物追上？三个人一起死在...

say:29:1064203021:1.text: Wait... It happened before... Micah clearly...
say:29:1064203021:1.source_cn: 上次……对啊，还有上次。迈克尔他明明——

say:33:1064203023:1.text: He's calling for your help. You're the only one who can save him.
say:33:1064203023:1.source_cn: ……他在向你求救。只有你能救他。

say:35:1064203025:1.text:
Ahhh... No. NO!!!
I can't save him... I don't want to!
say:35:1064203025:1.source_cn: 啊啊啊……不……不、不、不!\n我不能救他……我不想救他！

say:36:1064203026:1.text: Oh, how pathetic. A coward through and through.
say:36:1064203026:1.source_cn: 噢，天哪……真是一只软脚虾，一个彻头彻尾的懦夫！

say:38:1064203028:1.text: Where's that man who once trailed after the recruiter, vowing he'd grow into a soldier who'd never back down? Did you throw those vows away too, like a pair of worn-out boots?
say:38:1064203028:1.source_cn: 当年你追在征兵官屁股后面，保证成为永不退缩的战士的誓言...

say:39:1064203029:1.text: Oh, even worn-out boots still have some use on the battlefield. You? You don't. You're nothing but—
say:39:1064203029:1.source_cn: 哦不不，磨破的靴子在战场上还有回收利用价值。你呢？你可...

say:41:1064203031:1.text: That voice again... Who's talking? Who is it?
say:41:1064203031:1.source_cn: 又是那个声音……到底是谁在说话！谁？！

say:42:1064203032:1.source_cn: 什……什么声音？我没有听到啊……

say:43:1064203033:1.text: You must be too nervous, Ain...
say:43:1064203033:1.source_cn: 埃因哥哥，是不是你太紧张了？嗯……一定是这样的。

say:44:1064203034:1.text: Relax. You don't have to be afraid. You're just... um... shaken.
say:44:1064203034:1.source_cn: 放轻松……不用紧张。你只是，唔……只是心里有些动摇……

say:46:1064203036:1.text:
You're right...
Why I chose to join the army... and the promise I made... No one knows that better than I do.
say:46:1064203036:1.source_cn: ……对，你说得对。\n加入军队的原因，曾经许下的誓言，...

say:47:1064203037:0.text: Why did you join the army?
say:47:1064203037:0.source_cn: 你加入军队的原因……是什么？

say:48:1064203038:1.text:
To crush the Hypofiends. To protect others...
And I will never retreat.
say:48:1064203038:1.source_cn: ……击溃魔物，保护他人……\n……永不退缩。

say:49:1064203039:0.text: Good. You haven't forgotten who you are.

say:50:1064203040:0.text: Then please, save Micah... just like how you chose to save me.
say:50:1064203040:0.source_cn: 那么，请救救迈克尔吧……就像，你愿意对我伸出援手那样。

say:55:1064203043:0.text: Micah, hang on... I swear I'll get you out of this hellhole!
say:55:1064203043:0.source_cn: 迈克尔，再坚持一下……我一定会带你离开这个破地方！

say:58:1064203046:1.text: Come on. You're my comrade, remember?
say:58:1064203046:1.source_cn: 别说这些。你可是我的战友！

say:59:1064203047:1.source_cn: 走！先穿过前面那片树林！

narration:61:1064203048:0.text: Under the cover of night, the three of them support one another as they make their way toward the rear of the battlefield.
narration:61:1064203048:0.source_cn: 夜幕之下，三人互相搀扶着走向战场后方

narration:62:1064203049:0.text: They haven't gone far before a vast shadow drops from above.
narration:62:1064203049:0.source_cn: 还没走出太远，一道巨大的阴影突然从天而降

say:70:1064203052:1.text: No... not this again! I fought so hard to save Micah...
say:70:1064203052:1.source_cn: 又是……又是这样！我好不容易才救下迈克尔，你们却……

say:72:1064203054:1.text: I won't let you hurt anyone ever again... I'm taking Micah out of here!
say:72:1064203054:1.source_cn: 这一次我不允许你们再伤害任何人……我一定要带着迈克尔，...

say:3:1064204002:1.text: Micah! Aurora! See? I killed the Hypofiend! We can—
say:3:1064204002:1.source_cn: 迈克尔，奥萝菈！你们看到没？魔物消失了！我们——

narration:4:1064204003:0.text: Exhilarated, Ain turns back... and finds no one there.
narration:4:1064204003:0.source_cn: 埃因兴奋地回头望去，却发现身后空无一人

say:8:1064204006:1.text: Unease washes over him like a storm, drowning out that brief spark of hope and leaving only a smear of ash-black smoke behind.
say:8:1064204006:1.source_cn: 不安如同暴雨倾盆而下，刹那间浇灭了方才的兴奋，只余下缥...

say:9:1064204007:1.text: He runs blindly, endlessly, searching for them. His desperate shouts echo across the darkness.
say:9:1064204007:1.source_cn: 埃因一边在无涯的黑暗中狂奔，一边疯狂寻找着他们，漆黑之...

say:10:1064204008:1.text: Then a tiny light appears ahead. More lights gather, filled with a quiet, loving glow. Bit by bit, the frantic pounding of his heart begins to settle.
say:10:1064204008:1.source_cn: 直到一星光点出现在他面前，越来越多光向那里汇聚，那是充...

say:11:1064204009:1.text: A figure steps out of the light and approaches him. Ain narrows his eyes, trying to make out her face. Dura?
say:11:1064204009:1.source_cn: 一个身影从光中向他走来，埃因眯起眼睛想要看清对方的长相...

say:20:1064204015:0.text: Don't worry. I won't hurt you.
say:20:1064204015:0.source_cn: 无需担忧……我不会伤害你。

say:21:1064204016:1.text: I think you already know. I am a guide through dreams. I came here to lead you out of this terrible nightmare.
say:21:1064204016:1.source_cn: 也许你已经猜到，我是梦境的引路人。我来到这里，是为了引...

say:23:1064204018:1.text: You've been trapped in a nightmare for a long, long time.
say:23:1064204018:1.source_cn: 长久以来，你都被困在一场噩梦之中……

say:24:1064204019:1.text: Micah's death repeats itself again and again in a war that knows no end.
say:24:1064204019:1.source_cn: 噩梦中，战火连天……迈克尔临死前的场景一次又一次重复上演……

say:25:1064204020:1.text: And you try to get him out of the battlefield and save him every single time.
say:25:1064204020:1.source_cn: 而你，一遍遍地扶起他，想要将他带离战场，拯救他的生命……

say:26:1064204021:1.text: Not once could you leave him behind.
say:26:1064204021:1.source_cn: 没有任何一次，你真的狠下心，抛弃他。

say:27:1064204022:1.text: But... I never succeed, didn't I?
say:27:1064204022:1.source_cn: 但是……但是我没有真的救下他。对吗？

say:28:1064204023:1.text: And I lost my legs to it. I can't walk anymore.
say:28:1064204023:1.source_cn: 甚至……甚至我的两条腿也因此受伤，再也行动不了了……

say:29:1064204024:1.text: So part of you keeps wondering... "What if I hadn't tried to save him?"
say:29:1064204024:1.source_cn: 所以，你不断地想：假如……当时没有救他。

say:31:1064204026:1.text: But you are a kind soul. Deep down, a light within you has always resisted that dark thought...
say:31:1064204026:1.source_cn: 可你是一个善良的人。在你内心深处，光辉始终抵抗着这份灰...

say:32:1064204027:1.text: And where light and darkness collide, a shadow is born. That shadow becomes a demon that has tormented you all this time.
say:32:1064204027:1.source_cn: 光与暗的碰撞中，影子，诞生了……那便是一直折磨着你，令...

say:33:1064204028:1.text: But now, you defeated it. The nightmare is gone.
say:33:1064204028:1.source_cn: 但你看……你战胜它了。噩梦消散了。

say:35:1064204030:1.text: That was not your fault. War doesn't discriminate.
say:35:1064204030:1.source_cn: 那不是你的错。战争，从来都是无情的……

say:36:1064204031:1.text: And some survived thanks to you. Cate, Lorne, Samir...
say:36:1064204031:1.source_cn: 而且，你也成功救下了很多人，不是吗？凯特、劳恩、萨米尔……

say:37:1064204032:1.text: Read their letters. I can feel it... even in this dream, how deeply they still care about you.
say:37:1064204032:1.source_cn: 去看看他们寄来的信吧。我能感受到……即使在梦境之中，他...

say:38:1064204033:1.text: No... you don't get it... I should've died with them!
say:38:1064204033:1.source_cn: 不……你不懂……我不该活下来！

say:39:1064204034:1.text: I'm nothing but a deadweight! My mother, at her age, has to spend every day taking care of me!
say:39:1064204034:1.source_cn: 拖着这副无用的身躯，我是个累赘！我妈一把年纪还要成天照顾我！

say:40:1064204035:1.text: Oh, Aurora, he's still stuck on that? I'm half tempted to toss him right out of your lovely dream.
say:40:1064204035:1.source_cn: 噢……奥萝菈，他怎么还在纠结这件事？我有点想把他扔出你...

say:41:1064204036:1.source_cn: ——又是那声音！\n<shk>谁？！到底是谁在说话？！...

say:42:1064204037:1.text: Please ignore him. Sonny is my friend and my partner.
say:42:1064204037:1.source_cn: 请别介意。桑尼是我的朋友，我的伙伴。

say:43:1064204038:1.text: But he does have a point. You can't stay here.
say:43:1064204038:1.source_cn: 不过，他说的也没错……你该离开这里了。

say:44:1064204039:1.text: Brave, kind soul. You need not fear what lies ahead. Someday, your wish will come true...
say:44:1064204039:1.source_cn: 不必为未来担忧。你是一个勇敢而善良的人，终有一日，你的...

say:47:1064204042:1.text: The deepest longing hidden inside... You'll have your answer soon.
say:47:1064204042:1.source_cn: 潜藏于内心的……最深切的愿望。你很快就会得到答案。

say:49:1064204044:1.text: Go and enjoy a beautiful morning.
say:49:1064204044:1.source_cn: 去吧……迎接一个美好的清晨。

say:50:1064204045:1.text: I wish you sweet dreams, always.

narration:52:1064204046:1.text: As soon as she finishes speaking, darkness swallows Ain's sight.

narration:53:1064204047:1.text: His memories seem to blur with it too.

narration:54:1064204048:1.text: After a while, birdsong wakes him at dawn.
narration:54:1064204048:1.source_cn: 不知多久之后，清晨的鸟鸣唤醒了他

say:57:1064204050:1.text: I had the strangest dream... What was it about?
say:57:1064204050:1.source_cn: 我好像做了一个奇怪的梦……梦到了什么来着？

say:58:1064204051:0.text: Ha... Have I spent so long bedridden that I've gotten stupid and even my memory's getting worse?
say:58:1064204051:0.source_cn: 哈……是因为一直躺着，连脑子也变笨了、记忆力也变差了吗？

say:59:1064204052:0.text: If I'm really never going to walk again—
say:59:1064204052:0.source_cn: 要是一辈子，我这双腿都——

say:61:1064204054:1.source_cn: 好像……好像可以挪动一点了？！

say:62:1064204055:1.text: Mom! Come here! I can feel my legs again!
say:62:1064204055:1.source_cn: 妈！妈——！快来啊！我的腿好像有知觉了！！

say:1:1064205001:0.text: As Ain's figure fades from the dream, the outline of a beautiful unicorn slowly takes shape beside Aurora.
say:1:1064205001:0.source_cn: 梦境之中，埃因的身影散去后，一个梦幻而俊美的独角兽轮廓...

say:3:1064205002:0.text: Hmm... That dreadful mess is finally over.
say:3:1064205002:0.source_cn: 哼……这场混乱的噩梦总算了结了。

say:4:1064205003:0.text: I'll be frank, Aurora. I'm honestly more concerned about his mind—imagine not even knowing what your wish is. Good grief.
say:4:1064205003:0.source_cn: 我得说句实话，奥萝菈。比起他的双腿，我更为他的头脑担心...

say:6:1064205004:0.text: Perhaps it's because once you allow yourself to hope, you also risk disappointment... and if that hope is crushed, an even deeper despair may swallow you whole.
say:6:1064205004:0.source_cn: 也许是因为，他不敢幻想双腿还能康复，唯恐希望落空，被更...

say:7:1064205005:1.text: You know, Sonny... I understand that feeling better than you might think.
say:7:1064205005:1.source_cn: 你知道吗？桑尼，其实，我很能理解那种心情……

say:8:1064205006:1.text: Dear Aurora, your one and only weakness is your kindness.
say:8:1064205006:1.source_cn: 亲爱的奥萝菈，你唯一的缺点就是太过善良了。

say:9:1064205007:1.text: If you ask me, you should've just let me into his dream. I'd have ended the war, wiped out the Hypofiends like a glorious hero, and that would've been the end of his nightmares.
say:9:1064205007:1.source_cn: 要我说，直接让我进入他的梦境，用潇洒的身姿扫除战火啊、...

say:10:1064205008:1.text: And with all that time saved, you could have had a lovely rest for once!
say:10:1064205008:1.source_cn: 节省下来的时间，让你多休息一会儿，美美地睡上一觉，那该...

say:11:1064205009:1.text: Perhaps... I was so careful because I saw my old self in him.
say:11:1064205009:1.source_cn: 或许……是因为我在埃因身上看到了自己，所以才格外细致地...

say:12:1064205010:1.text: Wh-What? What exactly does he have in common with you other than having a reasonably good heart?
say:12:1064205010:1.source_cn: 什——什么？！他除了心地还不错之外，有哪点能和你相较？...

say:13:1064205011:1.text: I was once like him too... bedridden for life because of my legs.
say:13:1064205011:1.source_cn: 但是，我也曾经和他一样……因为腿疾，被永远地困在床榻上。

say:14:1064205012:1.text: That was before Dura blessed me... before she ascended me to one of her Celestials.
say:14:1064205012:1.source_cn: 那时的我，还没有受到艾雅女神的眷顾，被擢升为半神……

say:15:1064205013:0.text: It's not a time I treasure, but rather a nightmare so deep and hopeless that I couldn't imagine ever waking from it.
say:15:1064205013:0.source_cn: 那不是什么值得珍藏的回忆……它宛如一场幽深绝望的噩梦，...

say:16:1064205014:0.text: Sleep was the happiest thing I knew, since dreams were the only yet brief escape from the pain.
say:16:1064205014:0.source_cn: 对那时的我来说，睡觉就是最幸福的事……因为在梦里，我可...

say:17:1064205015:0.text: There were times when I prayed to Dura to let me sleep forever—
say:17:1064205015:0.source_cn: 我常常向艾雅女神祈祷，祈祷自己能不再醒来。

say:18:1064205016:1.text: So, my family would be spared their worry... and I would be spared my pain.
say:18:1064205016:1.source_cn: 那样的话，我的家人不必再担忧。而我……也不必再忍受痛苦。

say:19:1064205017:1.text: I'm sorry, Aurora. I didn't mean to upset you.
say:19:1064205017:1.source_cn: 噢……抱歉，奥萝菈，我没有想惹你伤心……

say:20:1064205018:1.text: No worries... You see, I'm no longer trapped by illness now.
say:20:1064205018:1.source_cn: 没关系……你看，现在，我已经不会再被病魔所困了。

say:21:1064205019:1.text: It's precisely because of my time bedridden in despair that I understand Ain's pain more deeply.
say:21:1064205019:1.source_cn: 不过，正是因为经历过卧病在床的绝望，我才格外理解埃因心...

say:22:1064205020:1.text: And besides... his nightmare comes from that war.
say:22:1064205020:1.source_cn: 何况……他的梦魇，来源于那场战争……

say:23:1064205021:1.text: The damage it inflicted was not on his flesh, but on his spirit.
say:23:1064205021:1.source_cn: 战争给他带来的创伤，不在肉体……而在心灵。

say:24:1064205022:1.text: If we do nothing more than dispel the nightmare, without healing his wounds, then it may return in a few years... or even in a few months.
say:24:1064205022:1.source_cn: 如果我们不能治愈他内心的创伤，即便清除了噩梦，也许几年...

say:25:1064205023:1.text: Well... at least not every mortal's dream is quite this much trouble.
say:25:1064205023:1.source_cn: 唉！幸好不是每个凡人的梦境都这么麻烦。

say:26:1064205024:1.text: I much prefer the kind with beasts and ghosts. One good kick and a sharp warning, and they run off with their tails between their legs.
say:26:1064205024:1.source_cn: 我还是更喜欢那些只有野兽、幽灵出没的噩梦。稍微踹它们一...

say:27:1064205025:1.text: "Bring solace to those lost in despair. Shape sweet dreams for them... and most importantly, let the dreams give them the strength to face despair when morning comes."
say:27:1064205025:1.source_cn: “安抚世间绝望之人，为他们创造美丽的梦境……最重要的是...

say:28:1064205026:1.text: This is the duty Dura placed in my hands...
say:28:1064205026:1.source_cn: 这是艾雅女神留给我的嘱托……

say:29:1064205027:1.text: We'll have to work hard, Sonny, if we're to help everyone become as carefree as you.
say:29:1064205027:1.source_cn: 为了把大家都变得和你一样无忧无虑，我们得加油了，桑尼。

say:30:1064205028:1.text: Carefree? Me? I have far too much on my mind!
say:30:1064205028:1.source_cn: 无忧无虑？哪里无忧无虑？我要操心的事可太多了！

say:31:1064205029:1.text: Running off my feet clearing nightmares is one thing, but keeping watch so that the spiteful butterfly, Tasi doesn't sneak into your dreams and stir up trouble is another! Her talent for disaster is... Just mentioning her gives me a headache...
say:31:1064205029:1.source_cn: 除了清除凡人的噩梦，还要防着塔西那个坏心眼的小蝴蝶跑到...

say:32:1064205030:1.source_cn: 好了，好了……不要激动，桑尼。

say:33:1064205031:1.text: This is no time to rest. There are still so many people trapped in despair, waiting for the comfort that dreams can bring...
say:33:1064205031:1.source_cn: 现在还不是休息的时候。有很多人仍深陷绝望之中，等待着梦...

say:34:1064205032:1.text: Let's be on our way... to the next dream.
say:34:1064205032:1.source_cn: 我们现在就出发吧……去下一场梦境。

say:35:1064205033:1.text: May the sufferings of war soon fade from Esperia... and from mortal dreams alike.
say:35:1064205033:1.source_cn: 但愿，战争带来的创伤，能早日从伊索米亚……也从凡人的梦...

say:36:1064205034:1.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah, I'm coming. Whatever you say, dear Aurora.
say:36:1064205034:1.source_cn: 好好好……都听你的，亲爱的奥萝菈。

say:37:1064205035:1.text: With you standing guard over their dreams, those mortals truly are blessed.
say:37:1064205035:1.source_cn: 有你庇护他们的梦境，连我都替这些凡人感到荣幸呢。
